about: Where SystemVerilog folds (5.1): each file and its folds, [first line, last line] from 1, one to a line, the one reaching furthest. Read by both builds' tests -- Tools/ci/ViewModel.Tests/CodeFoldsTests.cs (CodeFolds, the desktop's) and test/folds.test.mjs (src/folds.js, the browser's) -- so the two hold to one answer.

files.name: a module, its parameters, its ports, an always and a case
comments: a block, a run of line comments, and keywords inside a comment and a string
a class: an extern function with no end, a function, a fork and a wait fork
an instance's parameters and connections
an end with no opening, a module never ended, and a begin never ended
